name: Kiryuu Mirei
source:
Wife of the branch manager, in her late 30s. She also works for the company. She is a career woman. 

She is strong-willed and strict with her subordinates. She has the temperament of a queen.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/gokuraku/joshibuka/mirei.html]official site[/url]]
